claim: A quiet revolution: flor wine without the spirit returns to legality.
because: The 2022 revision of the Jerez-Xérès-Sherry pliego put the ageing-zone expansion, the six old grape varieties, pagos, Fino Viejo and the en rama definition into effect. The Consejo's own page lists optional fortification (natural 15%+) separately, as 'Pending EU approval'. The European Commission approved it on 29 July 2025, and it took effect after publication in the Official Journal in August 2025. The model answer and explanation present unfortified Sherry as legal from the 2022 reform, but it was not legal until 2025.
fix: exp: "The 2022 revision expanded the ageing zone to the whole production zone, readmitted six pre-phylloxera grapes, and defined pagos, Fino Viejo and en rama. Optional fortification (wines reaching 15% naturally) was submitted in the same package but only approved by the EU on 29 July 2025, in force August 2025." ans: "Expanded the ageing zone and permitted grapes, and formalized categories (pagos, Fino Viejo, en rama); unfortified wines at a natural 15%+ were proposed then and legal from 2025"
